avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbe
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-adrenergic agonist activity may counteract doxazosin's antihypertensive effects and increase blood pressure
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue yohimbe supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra (Ma Huang)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic activity antagonizes doxazosin efficacy and increases cardiovascular stimulation risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; ensure patient avoids all ephedra-containing products

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce doxazosin plasma concentrations and efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure response; inform prescriber if St. John's Wort is used

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild stimulatory effects that could reduce antihypertensive efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for reduced blood pressure control

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium intake can antagonize doxazosin's antihypertensive effects
caution_foods.action: Encourage sodium restriction as part of hypertension management

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase doxazosin levels; effect typically mild
caution_foods.action: Moderate consumption acceptable; monitor for dizziness or orthostatic hypotension

monitoring_notes: Monitor orthostatic blood pressure, heart rate, and symptom control (BPH/hypertension) during therapy. Counsel patients on alpha-blocker side effects including dizziness, syncope risk, and importance of slow position changes.
